title: context-selection-vocabulary.v1
description: The vocabulary that decides whether a task is source-heavy, and the bound on how many CodeGraph queries a pack may carry. mqobsidian owns these words because they describe the stack's own semantics; mq-agent owns the act of applying them to a task (DEC-005). Consumers read this contract and must not keep a second copy of the values.

source_heavy_hints.description: Lowercase substrings that mark a task as source-heavy. Matched against the lowercased task text.

source_heavy_suppress.description: Lowercase substrings that veto the source-heavy classification even when a hint matches. Suppression wins, so a documentation task never pulls source queries.

max_codegraph_queries.description: Upper bound on CodeGraph queries emitted into one pack. A budget, not a target.
